notes:
## Added

- **External channels (Telegram):** chat with the agent from Telegram — each Telegram chat maps to an app conversation. Bidirectional bridge with auto-map and slash commands (`/new`, `/list`, `/conv`, `/stop`, `/status`, `/help`, `/workspace`). Bot tokens are stored in the profile vault; reply splitting, approval codes, and an activity watchdog keep turns reliable. A Channels settings tab wires it up and auto-registers the slash-command menu.
- **Subagent surfaces:** spawn-agent rows and an active-first subagent roster make multi-agent activity visible in the chat timeline.
- **Compact tool rows:** tool results collapse to a one-line snippet with structured shell results for denser timelines.

## Changed

- **Chat and composer:** `@`-mentions no longer duplicate attachment rows, live-generation tool cards stay pinned across mid-stream reloads, disclosure toggles no longer break stick-to-bottom, and the composer footer is responsive.
- **Shell chrome:** topbar menus support arrow-key navigation, hover/background use color-mix tokens, and resize-handle width is tracked correctly.
- **Agents and providers:** thinking overrides use substring model-family matching; Windows session roots strip the extended-length prefix.
